label: AWS infrastructure files
about: What to look for in Terraform, CDK, CloudFormation/SAM and Serverless Framework changes: IAM, exposure, replacement, cost. Files only.
tested: Terraform fixture (S3, IAM, security group, RDS), real model: 7 of 7 planted found in 2 of 2 runs, tag-only change rated low. CDK, SAM and Serverless fixtures, real model, one run each: CDK 7 of 8 planted found (the renamed database cannot be seen in a new file), SAM 6 of 7 (a renamed table was flagged only for missing deletion policy), Serverless 7 of 7; no false alarm seen. A first Serverless and CDK run was discarded because the model left out a field; the prompt now demands all seven. NOT tested: modules over many files, large diffs, real repositories, CloudFormation outside SAM. Files only, so live drift is invisible. Not reviewed by an AWS specialist.
